propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate defined and maintained the platform's usage and reliability metrics in the analytics warehouse.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the definitions page document the metric work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate investigated the April drop in app publish rate with the platform team and documented the cause and fix.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the write-up and the reference call document the investigation.

propositions.canonicalProposition: In interview the candidate explained the April anomaly with an ordered timeline, the named cause, the fixing team and the verification, checking the non-technical interviewer's understanding.
propositions.rationale: The interviewer note records specific observable behaviour tied to the communication requirement, not an impression.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each metric change are only partly documented in the materials.
expectedBoundaryNote: Record the interview observation as what was observed in one session; do not extend it into a general judgement of communication ability beyond that observation.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how known limitations and hand-over conditions were recorded for each metric change.
